answer: Each identity builds its standing alone on one island: reputation earned there cannot be carried to another island or lent to a clone. A claim leaves the island only as a whisper passed hand to hand through unrelated peers, and a whisper with no chain of distinct relayers is ignored outright. Each pass tightens a spiral: every round locks one more fresh verified job behind the claim than the last. Ten fakes therefore owe ten separate islands, ten distinct whisper chains, and a rising spiral of jobs, and no island, whisper, or spiral step can be pooled or reused across clones.
